timestamp_basis: Independent UTC clock observed immediately before this audit; host-OS recorded time is separately retained because clock skew was detected.
manifest_check: Performed separately after final manifest refresh
policy: Machine-specific network addresses, private host/account paths, credentials and private URLs are excluded. Generic loopback/wildcard constants, verified synthetic fixtures, numeric/slice syntax and explicitly authorized author metadata are distinguished from machine identifiers.
scope: Recursive text, gzip expansion, decoded gzip+base64 backups, relative Markdown/HTML resource links, known binary printable metadata, original evidence pins, license and team metadata. Image appearance is independently inspected; original pixels are not rewritten.
classification_note: An unchanged path-length software fixture with an explicitly synthetic account was inspected and distinguished from machine-specific paths. No circuit or source file was changed for this classification.
